original-tone.mp3 is an original three-second 440 Hz synthesized test tone, encoded with lamejs 1.2.1 at 44.1 kHz, mono, 128 kbps. It contains no artist recording and is used only by browser/desktop/package playback fixtures; it is not bundled in the application. Encoder tooling and cache live under .runtime/mp3-encoder and .runtime/npm-cache.

original-long-tone.mp3 is an original 65-second 440 Hz synthesized tone, encoded with the same lamejs toolchain for minimum-duration search and playback checks. It is never bundled in the app.
